bg=9
out=[[bg]*13 for _ in range(13)]
def put_tile(r0,c0,color,mask):
    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5): out[r0+r][c0+c]=color
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(3):
            if not mask[r][c]: out[r0+1+r][c0+1+c]=bg
put_tile(1,1,7,[[0,0,1],[0,0,1],[1,1,0]])
put_tile(1,7,5,[[0,1,0],[0,0,0],[1,0,1]])
put_tile(7,1,3,[[0,0,0],[1,0,1],[1,0,1]])
put_tile(7,7,2,[[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[1,0,1]])
print(len(out), [len(r) for r in out])
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
